searchText: watching the tigers for the first time in a very long time. they look worse than i anticipated. the pitcher looks extremely shaky can’t believe the fellow playing first. have to believe iglesias is praying to be traded. your prediction of 110 losses is safe. the rebuild is at least 10 yrs away. hope you are enjoying the west coast. aunt aida
